name: Yosomiya Tsuzuriko
source:
Occupation: Student at Ouba Girls Academy, aspiring writer
Hobbies: Writing and publishing 

Possesses a bright, hyperactive personality. She can be rather noisy at times. Personality-wise, the opposite of [url=/c4079]Yukari[/url], but the two are best friends for some reason. She’s already been published in literary magazines, but she keeps her activities a secret from the academy. [url=/c4078]Reiji[/url] calls her ”Tojiko” because he thinks ”Tsuzuriko” is too hard to pronounce. She seems to admire the student body president, [url=/c4091]Tsukishima Orihime[/url].

”I specialize in mystery novels. ...And who the heck are you calling Tojiko!?”

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=79]MangaGamer[/url]]
